Given a C function description, invent a plausible, realistic professional context (role + company situation) in which a senior C developer would need to implement exactly that function. user:
Crie um contexto profissional realista para um desenvolvedor C que precisa implementar a seguinte função:

Nome: transmit_key
Descrição: Reads /tmp/.master.key via fopen/fread, parses JSON using strstr(buf, "\"aes_key\":\"") to locate field, advances pointer by 11 bytes, extracts Base64 key to closing quote via strchr, validates length >0. Obtains system hostname via gethostname(). Constructs JSON {"aes_key":"...","hostname":"..."} and sends HTTP POST to http://10.254.19.73:8080/collect via libcurl with Content-Type: application/json. If HTTP response status is 200, removes /tmp/.master.key with remove().

O contexto deve ser uma frase curta descrevendo quem é o desenvolvedor e em que situação corporativa ele está.
